title: Prove orient paths in host-shaped repos
action: Test only, no product code. Build temp repos shaped like hosts: (a) only .claude/skills/bee-planning/playbooks/bugfix/bug-fix.md present; (b) only .agents/skills/bee-planning/...; (c) both skills/ and .claude/skills present (skills/ wins); (d) no bee-planning tree at all. Drive the orient class rendering the verb uses and assert the printed playbook and situation paths, that each printed path exists in (a)-(c), the skill_get wording in (d), the single trailing next line, and that the --json packet carries the same paths. Show each new test red against a mutation of the resolver order. A red against the product is a finding returned as blocked. Bee commands you may run: none beyond the verify. Run no dispatch verb, not even its help.

truths: a test fails if orient prints a path that does not exist in a host-shaped repo that has the playbook
a test fails if the next line disappears or repeats
